programme.title: Notre Dame vs. Miami

programme.title: Florida vs. Miami

programme.title: Miami vs. Florida State
programme.desc: The No. 3 Hurricanes visit the No. 18 Seminoles. Miami leads the rivalry series 36-33 after beating Florida State 36-14 in 2024. FSU is coming off a double-overtime loss to Virginia on Sept. 26. Miami last played Sept. 20, beating Florida 26-7.

programme.title: Louisville vs. Miami
programme.desc: The Cardinals (4-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against a tough foe in the No. 2 Hurricanes (5-0, 1-0). Louisville dropped its first game of the season in a 30-27 overtime decision versus Virginia on Oct. 4. Miami defeated Louisville 52-45 last year.

programme.title: Stanford vs. Miami
programme.desc: The No. 9 Hurricanes (5-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against the Cardinal (3-4, 2-2). Miami was held to a season-low 63 rushing yards in its first loss of 2025, 24-21 to Louisville at home Oct. 17. This is the first meeting between these programs.

programme.title: Miami vs. Southern Methodist University
programme.desc: The No. 10 Hurricanes (6-1, 2-1) head to Big D for an ACC affair with the Mustangs (5-3, 3-1). SMU won the only prior meeting, 7-3 in 1965. Miami bounced back from a stunning setback against Louisville with a 42-7 victory over Stanford last week.(n)

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
